types.description: Per-tenant UI branding and theming for a frontend app (app names, logos, favicon, light/dark palettes, gradients). Singleton per tenant via rtWellKnownName = 'Branding'. Derives from UIElement (same as Dashboard, ProcessDiagram, SymbolDefinition, SymbolLibrary) — consistent with SystemUiCkModel convention.
A configurable dashboard containing multiple widgets arranged in a grid layout.
A widget within a dashboard that displays data in a specific visualization format.

Describes how the Refinery Studio lists, creates and edits entities of TargetCkTypeId (and, with IncludeDerivedTypes, its subtypes). Resolution: exact type first (tenant forms win over seeded ones, then Priority), then the nearest base type with IncludeDerivedTypes. The seeded form 'form-default' on System/Entity ends the chain, so every type has a form. Attributes a form does not mention are generated from CK metadata unless GenerateRemainingFields = false. Derives from UIElement (same as Branding, TreeNavigationConfiguration) — consistent with SystemUiCkModel convention.

A folder of the Studio's library. Folders nest through FolderParent (top-level folders have no parent) and hold items (e.g. persistent queries) through FolderItem. Deleting a folder does not cascade - clients must move its subfolders and items up to the parent first.

Per-tenant configuration for the Mapping Coverage page (communication data-mappings). Stores which CK types act as mapping-source catalogues in the Orphan Sources tab (e.g. Loxone/Control, MQTT/Topic, OpcUa/Node) so the selection is shared by all operators of the tenant instead of living in browser localStorage. Singleton per tenant via rtWellKnownName = 'MappingCoverage'. Optional: when absent the Orphan Sources tab starts empty. Derives from UIElement (same as Branding, Dashboard, TreeNavigationConfiguration) — consistent with SystemUiCkModel convention.
HMI-style process diagram with tanks, pipes, valves, pumps, and other industrial elements.
A reusable symbol definition composed of primitives, belonging to a symbol library.
A library containing reusable symbol definitions composed of primitives for process diagrams.

Per-tenant configuration for the entity trees (repository browser + communication data-mappings). Overrides which auto-discovered association roles are shown, their label, order, grouping and icon (Roles), and defines additional switchable tree perspectives with their own root (Perspectives). Singleton per tenant via rtWellKnownName = 'TreeNavigation'. Optional: when absent the trees fall back to pure auto-discovery and the spatial perspective only. Derives from UIElement (same as Branding, Dashboard) — consistent with SystemUiCkModel convention.

associationRoles.description: Places an item (e.g. a persistent query) in a folder of the Studio's library. An item sits in at most one folder; the runtime enforces this on mutations, but RT import does not — importers must not create duplicate memberships.

Links a subfolder to its parent folder in the Studio's library. Top-level folders have no FolderParent edge. RT import does not enforce the ZeroOrOne multiplicity — importers must not create a second parent.

Whether the list view offers creating new entities of this type. Absent = true.
Whether the list view offers deleting entities of this type. Absent = true.
Whether the list view offers duplicating an entity (opens the create form prefilled with its values). Absent = false.

Key of a dedicated frontend component that replaces the generated form for this type (e.g. for editors the generic form cannot express). Unknown keys fall back to the generated form. Absent = generated form.
Per-attribute presentation and validation overrides. Absent / empty = every attribute is generated from CK metadata (when GenerateRemainingFields is not false).

Whether attributes of the target type that no EntityFormField mentions are generated from CK metadata and appended in an extra section titled GeneratedSectionTitle. false = only the listed Fields are shown. Absent = true.
Title of the section holding the generated remaining fields (see GenerateRemainingFields). Absent = 'Further attributes'.
Optional icon name for the type's list and form header, resolved by the frontend against its known icon set. Absent = default entity icon.
Whether the form also applies to subtypes of TargetCkTypeId that have no form of their own (the nearest base type wins). Absent = false: the form applies to TargetCkTypeId only.
Columns of the entity list view, in definition order. Absent / empty = columns are derived from CK metadata.
Tie-breaker when several forms target the same type at the same source level (tenant forms always win over seeded ones first); the highest Priority wins. Absent = 0.
Sections (group boxes) the form is divided into; fields are assigned via EntityFormField.SectionKey. Absent / empty = a single generated section.
Whether the type is a per-tenant singleton: the Studio skips the list and opens the one entity (identified by SingletonWellKnownName) directly, creating it on first save. Absent = false.

rtWellKnownName of the singleton entity when Singleton = true (e.g. 'TreeNavigation', 'MappingCoverage'). Ignored when Singleton is absent or false. Absent with Singleton = true = the first entity of the type is used.

Runtime CK type id this form describes (e.g. 'EnergyIQ/Space', 'System/Entity'). Required. Resolution prefers a form whose TargetCkTypeId equals the entity's type; otherwise the nearest base type whose form sets IncludeDerivedTypes = true.
Attribute of the target type shown in this list column, by attribute name (e.g. 'Name', 'Address.City'). Required. Paths that match no attribute of the type are ignored.
How the cell value is rendered. Allowed values: 'text', 'chip', 'date', 'mono'. Absent = 'text'; unknown values behave as 'text'.
Column header. Absent = the attribute name, humanized.
Column width in pixels. Absent = auto.
For Editor 'reference': association role id the selection is stored in (e.g. 'System/ParentChild') instead of an attribute. Absent = the selection is stored in the attribute at AttributePath.
Attribute of the target type this field configures, by attribute name (e.g. 'Name', 'Address.City' for a nested record attribute). Required. Paths that match no attribute of the type are ignored.
Initial value prefilled when creating a new entity, as a string parsed according to the attribute value type. Absent = the CK attribute default, if any, otherwise empty.

Editor widget for the field. Allowed values: 'auto', 'text', 'multiline', 'password', 'number', 'toggle', 'enum', 'datetime', 'url', 'email', 'json', 'yaml', 'cron', 'reference', 'records'. Absent = 'auto' (derived from the attribute value type); unknown values behave as 'auto'.
Help text shown with the field. Absent = the CK attribute description, if any.
Whether the field is omitted from the form (the attribute is neither shown nor generated). Absent = false.
Label shown for the field. Absent = the attribute name, humanized.
Maximum allowed value for numeric attributes (inclusive). Ignored for non-numeric attributes. Absent = no upper bound.
Minimum allowed value for numeric attributes (inclusive). Ignored for non-numeric attributes. Absent = no lower bound.
Ordering hint among the fields of its section (ascending). Absent = definition order, after fields with an explicit Order.
Regular expression the string value must match. Absent = no pattern check.
Placeholder text shown in an empty input. Absent = no placeholder.

When the field is read-only. Allowed values: 'never' (editable), 'always', 'afterCreate' (editable only while creating, read-only when editing an existing entity). Absent = 'never'; unknown values behave as 'never'.

For Editor 'records' (RecordArray attributes): the record attributes shown as grid columns, each entry 'Path:Label' (Label optional, e.g. 'Key:Key', 'DisplayName:Name'). Absent / empty = columns derived from the record's CK metadata.
For Editor 'reference': runtime CK type id whose entities are offered for selection (e.g. 'EnergyIQ/Space'). Absent = derived from the attribute or association metadata.

For Editor 'reference': comma-separated attributes of the referenced entities shown next to their name in the picker and for the current value, by attribute name in camelCase (e.g. 'repositoryUrl,channel'; a String, not a StringArray, because record values in blueprint seeds must be scalars); the picker reads exactly these attributes. List only non-secret attributes (a Secret attribute's value is never returned, so it would show nothing). Absent / empty = the name only.

Whether a value is mandatory. Absent = taken from the model (the attribute's isOptional). true makes an optional attribute mandatory in the form; false cannot loosen an attribute the model declares mandatory.
Whether the value is masked in the form and list (shown as dots, revealed on demand). Absent = false.
Key of the EntityFormSection this field belongs to. Absent or unknown key = the field goes into the first section (or the single generated section when no Sections are defined).

Condition on another attribute that controls visibility, as 'AttributePath=value' (visible when that attribute equals value) or 'AttributePath=*' (visible when that attribute has any value). Absent = always visible.
Horizontal size of the field in a two-column section. Allowed values: 'full', 'half'. Absent = 'full'; unknown values behave as 'full'.
Whether the section starts collapsed. Absent = false (expanded).
Number of field columns in the section layout: 1 or 2. Absent = 1. Other values behave as 1.
Optional explanatory text shown below the section heading. Absent = no text.
Stable identifier of the section, unique within the form; referenced by EntityFormField.SectionKey. Required.
Ordering hint among sections (ascending). Absent = definition order, after sections with an explicit Order.
Heading shown for the section. Absent = Key is shown.
Library section the folder belongs to (e.g. "Queries"). Folders of different scopes form separate trees.
Optional position of the folder among its siblings (ascending); folders without a value sort by name.

Additional switchable tree perspectives (each with its own root + navigation whitelist) offered next to the built-in spatial perspective. Absent / empty = only the spatial perspective (today's behaviour); the perspective switcher is hidden.

records.description: One column of the entity list view for the form's target type, addressed by AttributePath. Absent / empty ListColumns = the list view derives its columns from CK metadata.

Presentation and validation override for one attribute of the form's target type, addressed by AttributePath. Every property is optional except AttributePath; absent properties fall back to what the CK metadata implies. Attributes without an EntityFormField entry are generated from CK metadata unless the form sets GenerateRemainingFields = false.

A named section (group box) of an EntityForm. Fields reference it via EntityFormField.SectionKey; sections render ordered by Order, then definition order. Absent / empty Sections = all fields go into one generated section.
Two-stop linear gradient definition. Rendered at 90deg (to-right) by ThemeService — no angle override persisted.
Color palette consumed by ThemeService to generate the Kendo CSS variable set. All fields optional — consumers fall back to per-app defaults when absent.

A single override rule for one association role of one source CK type (or all types via '*'). Matched by (SourceCkTypeId, RoleId); the most specific match wins (exact type over '*'). All presentational fields are optional and fall back to auto-discovery defaults.

A single switchable tree perspective for the entity trees (repository browser + communication data-mappings). A perspective defines its own root (the spatial ParentChild tree, or all instances of a CK type) and an optional primary/secondary navigation whitelist applied at the root level. Absent / empty Perspectives = only the built-in spatial perspective, i.e. today's behaviour.
